title: 第五章王璃 系统那我就献丑了新书求推荐票求收藏第六章冤有头债有主新书求推荐票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第五章王璃：系统，那我就——献——丑——了！
【新书，求推荐票，求收藏】
“这个～那个～谁能告诉我，我～我该怎么选？”
王璃同学面对自己金手指的第一次发威，不出意外的开始选择困难起来。
毕竟这可不是在外面的时候。
自己在外面，一旦遇到选择困难，从来都是李元竹来帮忙，元竹兄她每次都能把自己的选择困难症治理的服服帖帖，让自己没有一点后顾之忧。
可现在这里就自己一个人啊，我该怎么办？
但说一千道一万，即使王璃脑子里再怎能进水，他心情也清楚，此刻自己的选择，直接将会导致自己未来究竟会走向什么样的道路。
严格来说，这可比高考更加能决定自己的未来。
一旦职业选错了，后面的的超凡传承，还有超凡兵器，弄不好就全拐进沟里去了。
就好像同是武力侧的“武者”
职业范畴，奇幻侧里千万菜刀炮灰队里的一员是“武者”
可玄幻侧可以开天辟地，蜷缩岁月，拿时光大河当面团揉的至强，在理论上也是“武者”
啊！
这里面差距，是個人就能看得清清楚楚。
“可怎么偏偏是“武者”
呢？这不是在难为我小王同学吗？”
毕竟…王璃同学自己都知道，就自己那不堪入目的武道资质，这辈子估计也就基本告别自行车了。
可活在这世界里，有些东西，你不得不去争取啊。
再怎么样，自己也要比妹妹和弟弟那两个厉害吧？

王璃觉得，再放任那两小冤种往下走，自己这辈子都别想翻身了！
重塑哥哥的威严，吾辈义不容辞！
谁敢挑衅大哥的威严，我王璃就一定让他知道我拳头的厚重！
深吸一口气，在心底已经略有准备的王璃，试着跟这个看上去有些智障的系统沟通：“系统，只能选择武力侧武者类的超凡职业吗？”
“是。”
“那我就选修行了【无龙心法】的武者，要不然‘彼岸武者’这个超凡职业也可以，我不挑。”
王璃眼珠子一转，非常腹黑道。
“就是不知道这系统所谓‘元始’是什么，它的上限在哪里，这样的超凡职业，还有传承能不能真的选择……”
想要试图摸一摸，看一看系统底裤是什么颜色，又是什么式样的王璃同学，这一刻也心头忐忑不定。
系统：“……？？？”
content_en:
Chapter 5 Wang Li: System, then I will show my ugliness!
[New book, please vote for recommendation, please collect]
"Who can tell me about this, that, what should I choose?"
Faced with his golden finger's first display of power, classmate Wang Li suddenly found it difficult to make a choice.
After all, this is not the time to be outside.
When I am outside, whenever I encounter difficulty in making a choice, it is always Li Yuanzhu who comes to help. Brother Yuanzhu manages her difficulty in making a choice every time, so that she has no worries at all.
But now I am alone here, what should I do?
But to be honest, no matter how hard Wang Li's mind was, he knew clearly that his choice at this moment would directly lead to the path he would take in the future.
Strictly speaking, this can determine your future more than the college entrance examination.
Once you choose the wrong profession, the extraordinary inheritance and extraordinary weapons that follow will all turn into a ditch.
It’s like they are both “warriors” on the military side
In the professional field, in the fantasy side, a member of the cannon fodder team with thousands of kitchen knives is a "warrior"
But the fantasy side can open up the world, curl up the years, use the river of time as dough to knead the strongest, and in theory is also a "warrior"
Ah!
The difference here can be seen clearly by an individual.
"But why is he a "warrior"?
What? Isn't this making things difficult for my classmate, Xiao Wang? "
After all... Wang Li himself knows that with his unsightly martial arts qualifications, he will probably never bid farewell to bicycles in this life.
But living in this world, there are some things that you have to fight for.
No matter what, you must be better than your sister and brother, right?
Wang Li felt that if he allowed those two little enemies to continue their downward spiral, he would never be able to stand up again in his life!
It is our duty to restore the majesty of my brother!
Whoever dares to challenge the majesty of eldest brother, I, Wang Li, will definitely let him know the weight of my fist!
Taking a deep breath, Wang Li, who was already a little prepared in his heart, tried to communicate with the system, which seemed to be a bit mentally retarded: "System, can you only choose extraordinary professions such as martial arts warriors?"
"Yes."
"Then I will choose a warrior who has practiced the [Wulong Heart Technique]. Otherwise, the extraordinary profession of 'Warrior of the Other Side' is also available, so I won't choose."
Wang Li rolled his eyes, he was very sinister.
"I just don't know what the so-called 'original' is in this system, what is its upper limit, and whether such an extraordinary profession and inheritance can really be chosen..."
Classmate Wang Li, who wanted to touch and see what color and style the system underwear was, felt uneasy at this moment.
system:"……???"
